newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine pension fund plans U.S. investments.
newsitem.headline: Philippine pension fund plans U.S. investments.

text.p: A state-run Philippine pension fund hopes to obtain Congress' approval this year to invest about $500 million in foreign markets, fund officials said on Sunday.

The Social Security Systems (SSS), whose members are employees of private companies, is considering investing in U.S. treasury bills and blue-chip issues in New York and London, fund administrator Renato Valencia told reporters.
"If there are good investment opportunities abroad, why should we limit our investments in the domestic markets?" Valencia said.
A bill that would authorise the SSS to invest overseas 10 percent of its total investible funds has been approved by the House of Representatives and is up for debate in the Senate.

The fund's total investments as of September amount to 131.9 billion pesos ($5 billion), all locked in government securities and stocks. The amount represents 94 percent of its total assets of 140 billion pesos ($5.3 billion).
